Extreme Sampling Metrics

extreme_sampling_metrics.Rd

Computes a suite of metrics for evaluating how effectively a sampling strategy captures extreme observations.

Usage

extreme_sampling_metrics(
  full_values,
  sampled_mask,
  percentile = 0.99,
  alpha = 2
)

Arguments

full_values

Numeric vector containing the complete time series.

sampled_mask

Logical vector indicating sampled observations.

percentile

Percentile threshold used by Extreme Recall and Oversampling Factor. Default is 0.99.

alpha

Weighting exponent used by Tail-Weighted Recall. Default is 2.

Value

A tibble with one row containing:

extreme_recall

Extreme Recall score

oversampling_factor

Oversampling Factor

tail_weighted_recall

Tail-Weighted Recall

percentile_exposure

Percentile Exposure

percentile

Percentile threshold used

alpha

Tail-weighting exponent used
